A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same UPCSC research work, with readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and supplementary sections A–J. Full text comparison and page rendering establish that differences are confined to an affiliation typo and the arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original UPCSC experiments on four SSDG benchmarks in Tables 2–5, with additional ablations and comparisons in supplementary Tables A–D.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original benchmark experiments, ablations, and feature and training analyses, including the supplementary results.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm A retain identical UPC and SC components, positive/negative pair selection, surrogate-class construction, and training objectives.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same SSDG tasks on PACS, OfficeHome, DigitsDG, and miniDomainNet, with identical domain and class coverage in supplementary section A.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: ERM, MeanTeacher, FreeMatch, FixMatch, and StyleMatch in Tables 2–3; FBCSA and DGWM plug-and-play comparisons with FixMatch/StyleMatch in Table 4 and FreeMatch in Table D.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 retains the same 5/10-label settings, ImageNet-pretrained ResNet18, batches of 16 labeled and 16 unlabeled samples per domain, 20 training epochs, and top-1 accuracy evaluation. Supplementary experimental procedures are also unchanged.

E4.justification: The component ablations in Table 5 and supplementary Tables A–C, unlabeled-data accuracy curves, t-SNE visualizations, and loss-landscape analyses in Figures 5–7 and A–B are identical.

E5.justification: Both report averages over five random seeds and the same uncertainty entries in Tables 2–4 and D. No run-count disclosures or statistical reporting practices change.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and plotted findings are unchanged, including supplementary results. For example, Table 2 reports FixMatch + Ours at 79.6 ± 0.7 on PACS with 10 labels per class in both versions.

T1.justification: The problem formulation and domain assumptions in Section 3.1, candidate/excluded class definitions, and equations (1)–(7) are identical. No mathematical reasoning or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same novelty claim about using unconfident-unlabeled samples in SSDG, plug-and-play contribution, and claims of improved performance, class discriminability, and reduced domain gaps.

C2.justification: The explanations of how unconfident-unlabeled samples provide useful supervision and the interpretations of feature separation and flatter minima remain identical. No limitations or applicability qualifications are added or removed.

D1.justification: Implementation details and learning rates in Section 5.1, Algorithm A, supplementary loss descriptions, and code-asset attribution are unchanged. The code-availability link and its destination are also identical.

R1.justification: Section 2, citations throughout the paper, and all 32 references are unchanged, as is the positioning relative to prior DG, SSL, and SSDG methods.

P1.justification: The affiliation spelling changes from 'Seoul National Univeristy' to 'Seoul National University,' and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. No other wording or document-structure changes occur.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, and page arrangements are unchanged. Pages 2–15 render identically; first-page visual differences are confined to the corrected affiliation letters and updated arXiv stamp.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects an affiliation typo and updates the version stamp, while retaining identical scientific content and supplementary material. This small improvement in surface polish does not meaningfully alter the paper's overall clarity, evidential support, or reproducibility.
